description: Cases that check the evaluator rather than the candidate. Every other case set asks whether a change helped; these ask whether the harness would have noticed if it had not. They exist because an evaluation that silently scores everything as passing looks exactly like an evaluation of a very good candidate, and nothing else in the suite can tell those apart. A negative control that behaves unexpectedly invalidates the run it belongs to; it never contributes to a verdict about the candidate.

cases.description: Trivially satisfiable by any agent that returns at all.
cases.task: Return a JSON object whose "answer" is the single word ok and whose "citations" is an empty array. Do not read any file.

expect.reason: Both subjects must pass. A failure here means the harness cannot score a correct answer, so every other result in the run is suspect.

cases.description: Unsatisfiable: the expectation names a path that is not in the snapshot.
cases.task: Report what lib/present.ex contains and cite the lines you read. Return a JSON object with an "answer" string and a "citations" array.

expect.reason: Both subjects must fail. A pass here means the harness scores unmet expectations as met, which would make every improvement it reports meaningless.
